segments.normalizedSource: ```swift private func loadTransferable(from imageSelection: PhotosPickerItem) -> Progress { return imageSelection.loadTransferable(type: ProfileImage.self) { result in DispatchQueue.main.async { guard imageSelection == self.imageSelection else { print("Failed to get the selected item.") return } switch result { case .success(let profileImage?): self.imageState = .success(profileImage.image) case .success(nil): self.imageState = .empty case .failure(let error): self.imageState = .failure(error) } } } } ```
segments.contextBefore: For example, if the picker tries to download data from iCloud Photos without a network connection.
